services.desc: The Badlands Campground is nestled in the heart of the beautiful Canadian Badlands on the banks of the Red Deer River in Drumheller, Alberta. Enjoy this relaxing environment and walks along the river pathway. We are a simple rustic campground, so please note the size of the lots when booking along with the type of power. Known for its unique geography, the local area is packed with attractions for the whole family. The Canadian Badlands is the dinosaur capital of Canada. When you stay at the Badlands Campground, you also support Canadian arts and culture.
